patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Makes Kick's dark background pure black for OLED screens, optionally with near-black cards and sheets. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps live streams and videos playing as audio when you leave Kick, using Kick's own audio notification. A second switch turns off the automatic picture-in-picture window. On by default, as on Twitch. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking for or forcing an app update. A patched Kick can't be updated from Google Play, so update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Bypass VOD ad sessions
patches_modified.description: Experimental: uses the original VOD URL instead of requesting a separate ad-session manifest. Does not remove ads stitched into live streams. Enable in Lurk settings after patching.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes Kick's name in the launcher and Android settings.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes known campaign and advertising click parameters from kick.com links in share sheets. Keeps timestamps, clip IDs, unknown parameters and fragments. Kick's current share links are already clean.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Kick under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Sharing sign-in with Kick's broadcaster app may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice of the screen Kick opens on instead of Home: Browse or Following. Links and notifications still open what they point to. Starts on Home. Choose another in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Sets the default adaptive quality ceiling to the selected height when that rendition exists. Kick can still choose a lower quality. The player's Auto option uses this ceiling. A lower starting ceiling can be set for mobile data in Lurk settings > Playback; it's off until then.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Disables Firebase Analytics collection, Insider and Datadog initialization/events, Mux/Datazoom player analytics and PAL nonce requests. Playback API requests remain necessary to obtain streams. Restart Kick after changing this setting. This does not remove video ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Starts Kick's feed previews switched off. Existing preferences and Kick's own autoplay switch keep working. Does not change intentionally opened streams.

patches_modified.name: Don't save searches
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from saving what you search for on this device. Searches you saved earlier stay until you remove them. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips
patches_modified.description: Hides Clips tabs in Browse, channels and categories, and the popular-clips row on channels. Shared clip links still open.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides the featured carousel, recommended streams and categories rows on Home, each with its own switch. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide KICKs tipping
patches_modified.description: Hides the chat gift-shop button, KICKs purchase button and leaderboard tipping prompt.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_modified.description: Hides pinned messages, polls and predictions, goals, sub and gift messages, host messages, reward redemptions, event and drops banners, pinned KICKs gifts and celebration prompts, each with its own switch. Other chat messages are unchanged. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide rating prompt
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking you to rate the app. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides channel Subscribe and Gift a Sub buttons and the leaderboard gift-subscription prompt. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Kick's launcher icon with Lurk artwork, including Android's themed icon.

patches_modified.name: Normal latency
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that turns off low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay, fewer rebuffers on weak connections. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes advertising ID, ad attribution and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.

patches_modified.name: Seek interval
patches_modified.description: Sets how far the rewind and forward buttons skip in videos and rewound live streams: 5, 15, 20 or 30 seconds instead of 10. Starts at Kick's 10 seconds. Choose another in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through with a (Deleted), (Timed out) or (Banned) label, the way Kick's chat shows them to moderators, along with its ban, timeout and unban lines. Large KICKs gifts in chat also get the moderators' menu, whose Delete is meant for the channel's moderators. A second switch keeps the chat when a moderator clears it. Both on by default, as on Twitch. Turn them off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background audio. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stay on channel when it hosts
patches_modified.description: When the channel you're watching hosts another one, Kick's host dialog waits for you instead of switching when its countdown ends: Watch now still switches, Cancel stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds optional 7TV emotes to chat, the native picker and autocomplete, with zero-width layers and live set updates. Sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io, subscribes to set IDs at events.7tv.io and loads images from cdn.7tv.app. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a switch that shows the channel's 7TV emotes, and 7TV's global emotes, in live chat. When on, it sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io and loads emote images from cdn.7tv.app. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble's Ketch consent SDK from loading, so the cookie notice never appears and no consent is recorded, and ignores consent recorded earlier. Rumble then keeps the analytics and ad tracking it gates on consent switched off. After restarting, Airship does not start; this may affect push notifications. Settings > Data Consent no longer opens.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Rumble's Ketch consent SDK from loading, so the cookie notice never appears and no consent is recorded, and ignores consent recorded earlier. Rumble then keeps the analytics and ad tracking it gates on consent switched off. Push notifications stop too, since Rumble only starts its push service (Airship) with consent. Settings > Data Consent no longer opens.

patches_modified.name: Anonymous chat
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that reads chat as an anonymous guest, the way Twitch does when signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in, so you aren't listed among a channel's chatters. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on. Off by default; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Auto-claim channel points
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that claims the channel points bonus for your account as soon as its chest appears in a channel's chat, with the same request as tapping the chest. Each bonus is claimed once. Off by default; needs a signed-in account.

patches_modified.name: Avoid stitched ads
patches_modified.description: While Twitch's server stitches an ad break into a live stream, plays the stream instead from a picture-by-picture session, the kind Twitch itself shows during breaks, which gets no ads: at 360p at most, with sound, then back to the stream's own session and quality when the break is over. The player doesn't reload. The playback token for that session is requested without your account. When none can be had, the break plays, and Mute stitched ads still mutes and covers it. Native and React Native players; streams started while it's off are left alone.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps streams and videos playing as audio when you leave the app, using Twitch's own "Continue Playing Audio in the Background" with its audio-only stream and media notification. Changes only the default, Never in Twitch: a choice made in Twitch's settings still wins.

patches_modified.name: Block client ads
patches_modified.description: Declines ads handled by Twitch's native client ad eligibility check using its existing not eligible result. Does not remove ads stitched into streams by the server or guarantee ad-free playback.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
patches_modified.description: Hides Twitch's automatic cookie consent notice without accepting it or changing saved vendor consent. Manual consent settings stay available. Use Disable analytics to block tracking.

patches_modified.name: Block display ads
patches_modified.description: Blocks the ad requests that Block client ads doesn't cover: stream display ads (squeezeback and lower third), audio ads, multi-format ad pods, the Following headliner, feed display and video ads and brand surveys, in both the native and React Native parts of the app. Each request gets the failure or no-ad answer Twitch already handles. Sponsorship and paid-promotion labels are kept. Ads stitched into the stream by the server still play.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes the name shown under Twitch's launcher icon and in Android's settings.

patches_modified.name: Chat appearance
patches_modified.description: Adds chat look settings: text size, alternating row backgrounds, plain /me messages, and the width and background opacity of the landscape chat panel. Each keeps Twitch's look until changed in Lurk settings. Native and React Native live chat and history, plus native VOD chat replay.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds chat look settings: text size, alternating row backgrounds, plain /me messages, and the width and background opacity of the landscape chat panel. Each keeps Twitch's look until changed in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; not React Native chat.

patches_modified.name: Chat keywords
patches_modified.description: Highlights chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty and are set in Lurk settings. Native and React Native live chat and history, plus native VOD chat replay.

Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty and are set in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; not React Native chat.

patches_modified.name: Chat overlay
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that scrolls live chat messages right to left across the top of the video in landscape (danmaku), as plain white text with the sender's name. Off until turned on in Lurk settings, with choices for speed and number of lines. Native live channels only: not React Native chat, VODs or chat replay. The overlay never takes touches.

patches_modified.name: Chat timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows the time each live chat message was sent in front of it, the way Twitch already shows it on chat history, in 24-hour or 12-hour format. Whispers are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes known Twitch attribution and campaign parameters from shared links and copied share text. Keeps timestamps, clip IDs, unknown parameters and fragments. Covers native and React Native sharing.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Twitch under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Amazon sign-in and verified app links may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice of the screen Twitch opens on instead of Home: Browse, Following or Activity. Links and notifications still open what they point to.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts playback at the selected rendition when available, with Source as the default. Saved player choices, including Auto, take priority. Unavailable renditions use Twitch's fallback.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Twitch's native and React Native Spade event uploads, denies local analytics SDK consent, enables Branch's limited tracking mode, blocks Crashlytics uploads, Nielsen audience pings and Sprig surveys, and prevents Sentry initialization. Watch progress, viewing statistics and rewards may stop updating. Restart Twitch after changing this setting. Playback requests still run.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops the next recommended video and React Native feed clip from playing automatically, and defaults feed previews to Never. Manual Play and saved feed preview choices keep working.

patches_modified.name: Fix notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app register for push notifications. Firebase only accepts Twitch's original package name and signing certificate, and refuses the re-signed app, so its registration requests send the original ones.

patches_modified.name: Fix stuck start screen
patches_modified.description: Opens Twitch when its start screen is still waiting after 5 seconds. Twitch waits for Branch's link lookup before it routes, and when that never answers, it stays on a blank start screen until it's closed, unpatched Twitch included.

patches_modified.name: Force ExoPlayer
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that plays live channels and videos with the ExoPlayer backend Twitch still ships instead of Amazon IVS. Off until turned on in Lurk settings. Clips, encrypted streams and React Native players stay on IVS. Lurk patches that hook IVS, such as Normal latency, Mute stitched ads and Show video stats, don't act on ExoPlayer.

patches_modified.name: Hide Bits tipping
patches_modified.description: Hides chat Bits buttons, Bits purchase cards, the cheering tray and one-tap Bits controls. Keeps normal chat and Bits messages sent by other viewers.

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips
patches_modified.description: Hides the Clips discovery tab on Home and the Clips tab on native channel profiles. Shared clip links still open.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides Stories on Home and, each with its own switch, the Continue watching, offline channels and recommended channels sections of Following.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_modified.description: Hides the Hype Train, Bits and gift leaderboards, other viewers' sub and gift messages and gift banners, pinned cheers and watch-streak pop-ups, each with its own switch. Celebrations can be hidden too. Other chat messages are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Hide mature content warning
patches_modified.description: Skips the content warning on streams, videos and clips with mature content labels, as if you had chosen Start Watching. Age, region, guardian and account restrictions still apply. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Hide player buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the player's Clip, Cast and Share buttons, each with its own switch. Cast stays visible by default. Other ways to clip and share, such as the channel page, are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides Subscribe and Gift a Sub prompts, Turbo promotions and the native Turbo signup/startup offer. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator and legitimate account entitlements.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Twitch's launcher icon with Lurk artwork, including Android's themed icon.

patches_modified.name: Mute stitched ads
patches_modified.description: While an ad break that Twitch's server stitched into a stream plays, mutes the player and covers the video with black, then restores both when the stream returns. Works in the native and React Native players. The ad still plays and the break isn't shorter.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar position
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice that moves Twitch's bottom navigation bar to the top of the screen and/or hides its labels, leaving only the icons. Twitch's own layout stays until another choice is made in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Normal latency
patches_modified.description: Adds a setting that turns off the player's low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay to the broadcaster, for fewer rebuffers on a weak connection. Off until turned on in Lurk settings.

patches_modified.name: Player gestures
patches_modified.description: Sets the skip interval of the video (VOD) rewind and forward buttons and the media notification, and adds brightness (left) and volume (right) swipes on the video in landscape. Twitch's -10/+30 seconds stay until you choose another interval in Lurk settings; swipes start off.

patches_modified.name: Playlist proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends live stream playlist requests to a proxy server you set in this patch's options, for example one that returns playlists without stitched ads. The proxy receives each request in full, including your signed playback token, which identifies your account: only use a proxy you trust. An http:// proxy gets an exception from Twitch's HTTPS-only rule for its host alone, and the token then travels unencrypted. Does nothing while the proxy URL is empty. Videos and clips are not proxied.

patches_modified.name: Refresh stream
patches_modified.description: Long-press the player's settings gear, or the middle of the video, to reload a stuck stream through Twitch's own Retry: a new access token and playlist for live streams, the same position for videos. Covers Twitch's native players.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes advertising ID and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps the text of chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through and dimmed instead of Twitch's "message deleted" placeholder. A second switch keeps the messages when a moderator clears the whole chat.

patches_modified.name: Show video stats
patches_modified.description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server. Everything shown is local to the player.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, through Twitch's own pause for native, portal and React Native players, and says so in a short notice. Choose the time in Lurk settings; it is off until then.

patches_modified.name: Tablet layout
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that makes Twitch treat the phone as a tablet: Home and the player rotate, the player shows chat beside the video in landscape, and a navigation rail on the left replaces the bottom bar in landscape (and in portrait too with a second switch). Off until turned on in Lurk settings; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Third-party badges
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native and React Native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings; when on, it sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete.

patches_modified.name: Use native player
patches_modified.description: Always opens live channels in Twitch's native player, never the React Native "Ultralight" player a server experiment can switch some users to. Most Lurk playback, chat and ad patches hook the native player.

patches_modified.name: VOD chapters
patches_modified.description: Adds a Chapters button to the native video (VOD) player that lists the stream's game and category changes and jumps to one through Twitch's own seek. The list comes from Twitch's public data, fetched with the app's client ID. On by default.

patches_modified.name: Watch without signing in
patches_modified.description: Opens Twitch without an account instead of stopping at the Log In / Sign Up screen, using Twitch's own signed-out mode. Streams, videos and chat can be watched; following, chatting and other account actions still ask you to sign in. Signed-in use is unchanged.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Makes Kick's dark background pure black for OLED screens, optionally with near-black cards and sheets. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps live streams and videos playing as audio when you leave Kick, using Kick's own audio notification. A second switch turns off the automatic picture-in-picture window. On by default, as on Twitch. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Block update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking for or forcing an app update. A patched Kick can't be updated from Google Play, so update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Bypass VOD ad sessions
patches_modified.description: Experimental: uses the original VOD URL instead of requesting a separate ad-session manifest. Does not remove ads stitched into live streams. Enable in Lurk settings after patching.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes Kick's name in the launcher and Android settings.

patches_modified.name: Clean share links
patches_modified.description: Removes known campaign and advertising click parameters from kick.com links in share sheets. Keeps timestamps, clip IDs, unknown parameters and fragments. Kick's current share links are already clean.

patches_modified.name: Clone app
patches_modified.description: Installs Kick under another package name alongside the original, with separate sign-in and settings. Sharing sign-in with Kick's broadcaster app may not work after re-signing.

patches_modified.name: Default startup tab
patches_modified.description: Adds a choice of the screen Kick opens on instead of Home: Browse or Following. Links and notifications still open what they point to. Starts on Home. Choose another in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Sets the default adaptive quality ceiling to the selected height when that rendition exists. Kick can still choose a lower quality. The player's Auto option uses this ceiling. A lower starting ceiling can be set for mobile data in Lurk settings > Playback; it's off until then.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Disables Firebase Analytics collection, Insider and Datadog initialization/events, Mux/Datazoom player analytics and PAL nonce requests. Playback API requests remain necessary to obtain streams. Restart Kick after changing this setting. This does not remove video ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable autoplay
patches_modified.description: Starts Kick's feed previews switched off. Existing preferences and Kick's own autoplay switch keep working. Does not change intentionally opened streams.

patches_modified.name: Don't save searches
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from saving what you search for on this device. Searches you saved earlier stay until you remove them. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Clips
patches_modified.description: Hides Clips tabs in Browse, channels and categories, and the popular-clips row on channels. Shared clip links still open.

patches_modified.name: Hide Home sections
patches_modified.description: Hides the featured carousel, recommended streams and categories rows on Home, each with its own switch. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide KICKs tipping
patches_modified.description: Hides the chat gift-shop button, KICKs purchase button and leaderboard tipping prompt.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_modified.description: Hides pinned messages, polls and predictions, goals, sub and gift messages, host messages, reward redemptions, event and drops banners, pinned KICKs gifts and celebration prompts, each with its own switch. Other chat messages are unchanged. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide rating prompt
patches_modified.description: Stops Kick from asking you to rate the app. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide subscription upsells
patches_modified.description: Hides channel Subscribe and Gift a Sub buttons and the leaderboard gift-subscription prompt. Keeps the existing subscribed indicator.

patches_modified.name: Lurk icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces Kick's launcher icon with Lurk artwork, including Android's themed icon.

patches_modified.name: Normal latency
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that turns off low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay, fewer rebuffers on weak connections. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Remove tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes advertising ID, ad attribution and Google Play install-referrer permissions. Other identifiers and analytics require separate controls.

patches_modified.name: Seek interval
patches_modified.description: Sets how far the rewind and forward buttons skip in videos and rewound live streams: 5, 15, 20 or 30 seconds instead of 10. Starts at Kick's 10 seconds. Choose another in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through with a (Deleted), (Timed out) or (Banned) label, the way Kick's chat shows them to moderators, along with its ban, timeout and unban lines. Large KICKs gifts in chat also get the moderators' menu, whose Delete is meant for the channel's moderators. A second switch keeps the chat when a moderator clears it. Both on by default, as on Twitch. Turn them off in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer
patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background audio. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stay on channel when it hosts
patches_modified.description: When the channel you're watching hosts another one, Kick's host dialog waits for you instead of switching when its countdown ends: Watch now still switches, Cancel stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds optional 7TV emotes to chat, the native picker and autocomplete, with zero-width layers and live set updates. Sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io, subscribes to set IDs at events.7tv.io and loads images from cdn.7tv.app. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a switch that shows the channel's 7TV emotes, and 7TV's global emotes, in live chat. When on, it sends the channel owner's Kick user ID to 7tv.io and loads emote images from cdn.7tv.app. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
patches_modified.description: Stops Rumble's Ketch consent SDK from loading, so the cookie notice never appears and no consent is recorded, and ignores consent recorded earlier. Rumble then keeps the analytics and ad tracking it gates on consent switched off. After restarting, Airship does not start; this may affect push notifications. Settings > Data Consent no longer opens.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Rumble's Ketch consent SDK from loading, so the cookie notice never appears and no consent is recorded, and ignores consent recorded earlier. Rumble then keeps the analytics and ad tracking it gates on consent switched off. Push notifications stop too, since Rumble only starts its push service (Airship) with consent. Settings > Data Consent no longer opens.

patches_modified.name: Anonymous chat
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that reads chat as an anonymous guest, the way Twitch does when signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in, so you aren't listed among a channel's chatters. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on. Off by default; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Auto-claim channel points
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that claims the channel points bonus for your account as soon as its chest appears in a channel's chat, with the same request as tapping the chest. Each bonus is claimed once. Off by default; needs a signed-in account.

patches_modified.name: Avoid stitched ads
patches_modified.description: While Twitch's server stitches an ad break into a live stream, plays the stream instead from a picture-by-picture session, the kind Twitch itself shows during breaks, which gets no ads: at 360p at most, with sound, then back to the stream's own session and quality when the break is over. The player doesn't reload. The playback token for that session is requested without your account. When none can be had, the break plays, and Mute stitched ads still mutes and covers it. Native and React Native players; streams started while it's off are left alone.

patches_modified.name: Background audio
patches_modified.description: Keeps streams and videos playing as audio when you leave the app, using Twitch's own "Continue Playing Audio in the Background" with its audio-only stream and media notification. Changes only the default, Never in Twitch: a choice made in Twitch's settings still wins.

patches_modified.name: Block client ads
patches_modified.description: Declines ads handled by Twitch's native client ad eligibility check using its existing not eligible result. Does not remove ads stitched into streams by the server or guarantee ad-free playback.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice
patches_modified.description: Hides Twitch's automatic cookie consent notice without accepting it or changing saved vendor consent. Manual consent settings stay available. Use Disable analytics to block tracking.

patches_modified.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, through Twitch's own pause for native, portal and React Native players, and says so in a short notice. Choose the time in Lurk settings; it is off until then.

patches_modified.name: Tablet layout
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch that makes Twitch treat the phone as a tablet: Home and the player rotate, the player shows chat beside the video in landscape, and a navigation rail on the left replaces the bottom bar in landscape (and in portrait too with a second switch). Off until turned on in Lurk settings; applies after a restart.

patches_modified.name: Third-party badges
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native and React Native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings; when on, it sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete.

patches_modified.name: Use native player
patches_modified.description: Always opens live channels in Twitch's native player, never the React Native "Ultralight" player a server experiment can switch some users to. Most Lurk playback, chat and ad patches hook the native player.

patches_modified.name: VOD chapters
patches_modified.description: Adds a Chapters button to the native video (VOD) player that lists the stream's game and category changes and jumps to one through Twitch's own seek. The list comes from Twitch's public data, fetched with the app's client ID. On by default.

patches_modified.name: Watch without signing in
patches_modified.description: Opens Twitch without an account instead of stopping at the Log In / Sign Up screen, using Twitch's own signed-out mode. Streams, videos and chat can be watched; following, chatting and other account actions still ask you to sign in. Signed-in use is unchanged.
